text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokyo Daishoten. Hokko 
Tarumae reaffirms that she runs for 
Tomakomai. And she pledges to shine 
brightly as Tomakomai's star.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Awaiting her were Copano Rickey and Wonder 
Acute. Their Tokyo Daishoten is about to 
begin—!
